versions.changelog:
- Improved documentation for setup, including standalone and MCP endpoints.
- Clarified guidelines for handling advisory text and separating upstream content from deployment-specific notes.
- Added instructions for managing the change feed on first run, emphasizing date-bound queries and cursor persistence.
- Strengthened attribution and reporting standards for affected and fixed versions.
- Outlined best practices for privacy and compliance when encountering non-redistributable or deployment-specific data.
